title: Flaky: VS Code extension E2E (browser-debugger) times out waiting for Blazor page/WASM debug session to become interactive
test_name: Aspire Blazor browser debugger E2E hits a managed breakpoint for standalone
job_name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, browser-debugger)
error_pattern: Failed to apply E2E control revision <timestamp>: Error: Timed out after ~288-295s waiting for Blazor page/WASM root session to become interactive/attach. Last error: <none>. State: {"debugSessions":[{"id":"...","type":"monovsdbg_wasm","name":"Wasm Managed Debugger", ...}]}
analysis: The test times out waiting for the pwa-msedge child debug session for the Blazor WASM root to attach, a known recurring flaky-timeout pattern for this E2E shard unrelated to actual VS Code extension logic. The PR under analysis only modifies Azure ARM client provisioning internals and does not touch the VS Code extension or its debugger integration code.
